title: tc-cell-inspector
description:
Why one AI-filled cell says what it says – the value and confidence, the prompt with the row filled in, reasoning,
sources, tokens and cost, and history – with Accept, Edit value, Re-run and Mark as wrong.

heading.description: The heading – the column's name – and the region's name

description.description: A quiet line under the heading – which row: "Northwind Analytics · row 214"

value.description: The cell's value. Changed by Edit value unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

status.description: Where the cell stands. Changed by the actions unless a tc-status-change listener calls preventDefault()

prompt.description: The column's prompt, with {{variable}} where the row's values go

variables.description: This row's values, by variable name

model.description: The model that filled the cell

at.description: When it was filled, epoch ms

now.description: The time now, epoch ms – turns times into "3 min ago"; unset shows dates

reasoning.description: The model's reasoning summary, folded away until opened

confidence.description: How sure the model was, 0–1; unset hides it

closable.description: Show a close button – the panel's own; Escape fires tc-close either way

locale.description: Locale for numbers, money and dates

url.description: Opens the source; only http(s), mailto and relative links are kept

snippet.description: The passage the model used, quoted

by.description: Who or what set it: "Analyst model", "Priya Shah"

kind.description: A model run or a person (default "model")

note.description: Why it changed: "Re-run after the prompt changed"
